acceptanceCriteria: A table-driven test runs each shipped hook adapter (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode where hook-based) under: corvint binary absent, index unavailable, empty stdin, malformed stdin, stdout closed before write, and a host deadline shorter than the adapter's internal budget.

Every case exits with the host's non-blocking status and emits a FALLBACK or degradation code naming the cause; no case returns a blocking exit code, hangs past the host deadline, or writes outside the declared local ledgers.
The adapter's per-invocation process spawns are counted in the test and no adapter spawns a login shell.
body: Filed 2026-10-04 from the owner's request to learn from claude-mem (github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem, shallow clone at bfc50259f64a, 2026-10-03). Its plans/17-hook-wrapper-contract.md groups 25+ user reports where a hook blocked or looped the host: a login-shell PATH probe on every invocation (250-420 ms on macOS, 1-10 s on Git Bash), exit 2 on an unreachable worker turning the Stop hook into an endless wake loop, a global cross-session failure counter that escalated to blocking, printf write errors on a closed pipe, empty stdin silently disabling capture, and synchronous SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks whose internal budget equalled the host wire timeout. Their remedy is a contract: the wrapper resolves nothing it can cache, spawns nothing it does not need, never writes to a closed pipe, and cannot return a blocking exit code for an availability failure. Corvint adapters already degrade to FALLBACK (see completed V1-0286 and open V1-0607/V1-0396 for deadline reporting), but there is no single cross-host matrix proving the non-blocking property under each failure. Proposal: one table-driven conformance matrix run against every shipped hook adapter. This is an idea, not a confirmed defect: no Corvint hook has been observed blocking a host in this session.

completion.reason: Criteria 2 and 3 met and criterion 1 met with an owner-accepted replacement, by beamfall/corvint#531, merged 2026-10-04T20:38:53Z as cd70ba0a via auto-merge. Evidence digests = sha256 at main cd70ba0a of docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0711-fail-open-matrix.md and cmd/corvint/host_adapter_fail_open_test.go. (1) The table-driven matrix runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode under binary absent, index unavailable, empty stdin, malformed stdin and stdout closed; AHI-044. The host-deadline-shorter-than-budget case is REPLACED, not met: shipped timeouts are pinned equal to the declared kill (TestAHI017AdapterHostKillMatchesDeclaredHooks) and two delay cases force each adapter onto its own deadline first. The owner accepted this replacement criterion on 2026-10-04 in the orchestrator session. An early host SIGKILL path was not run. (2) Every case exits non-blocking with a FALLBACK or degradation code and no writes outside the declared ledgers. (3) Spawns are counted (PATH lookups only) and no login shell is spawned. Documented exemptions: binary absent for Claude Code and Codex, OpenCode in-process, roots outside Git. Real hosts NOT_OBSERVED; V1-0734 tracks Git children outliving the adapter.

title: hosts: fail-open conformance matrix for every hook adapter (worker absent, empty stdin, closed pipe, cold start, slow PATH)
